mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aqi_feedback (id, supervisor_id, grid_member_id, province_id, city_id, estimated_aqi, description, status, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{supervisorId}, #{gridMemberId}, #{provinceId}, #{cityId}, #{estimatedAqi}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, s.real_name AS supervisor_real_name, s.phone AS supervisor_phone, gm.real_name AS grid_member_name, gp.name AS province_name, gc.name AS city_name FROM aqi_feedback f LEFT JOIN supervisor s ON f.supervisor_id = s.id LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON f.grid_member_id = gm.id LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON f.province_id = gp.id LEFT JOIN grid_city gc ON f.city_id = gc.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.*, s.real_name AS supervisor_real_name, s.phone AS supervisor_phone, gm.real_name AS grid_member_name, gp.name AS province_name, gc.name AS city_name FROM aqi_feedback f LEFT JOIN supervisor s ON f.supervisor_id = s.id LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON f.grid_member_id = gm.id LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON f.province_id = gp.id LEFT JOIN grid_city gc ON f.city_id = gc.id WHERE f.supervisor_id = #{supervisorId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT f.*, s.real_name AS supervisor_real_name, s.phone AS supervisor_phone, gm.real_name AS grid_member_name, gp.name AS province_name, gc.name AS city_name FROM aqi_feedback f LEFT JOIN supervisor s ON f.supervisor_id = s.id LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON f.grid_member_id = gm.id LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON f.province_id = gp.id LEFT JOIN grid_city gc ON f.city_id = gc.id WHERE f.grid_member_id = #{gridMemberId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE aqi_feedback SET grid_member_id = #{gridMemberId}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE aqi_feedback SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
